why:
The finding is real, and the reviewer's edit is correct, but only if it lands together with its companion edit to 十六·十五. The second round's order fix moved 无以小害大 (stable 十六·十五, now rendered 十六·十) ahead of 兼权 (stable 十六·十四, now 十六·十一), and the round-2 finding said the explanation of 基 and 基辞 should move with it. That second part was never applied.

In the chapter now, 无以小害大 (line 3323) uses 基辞 ten times and names 先基后次之序 with no gloss. The only gloss of 基 and 基辞, with its name source 老子「高以下为基」 and its AI reading label, still sits in 兼权's 說 (line 3333), one 條 later. Neither 篇十六's intro nor the head defines it.

The Lean supports the clause the edit keeps. Lexical.lean says BasicPriority is "J1/J2 as a condition", meaning `better` iff `Above`, the order that ranks basic claims first and gains second. So 「它与无以小害大合为先基后次之序」 stays exact.

The find occurs once in 十六·十四's body. The new pointer reads ⟦十六·十五⟧ as a stable id, which renders as 十六·十.

The companion edit is required: if it is not applied, this one must not be applied either. Without it the book loses its only gloss of 基 and its name source, and the pointer would claim that 十六·十五 explains 基 and 基辞 when it does not. The companion edit, in 十六·十五's body, is as follows. Find (occurs once): 用它之定理都以它为前提（`Becoming.FrontierFrames.Priority` 是它在系辞上的写法）。 Replace with that same text followed by: 基是两层之比中先计之层，基辞是此层之辞；名取老子「高以下为基」〔YD-LAO-BASE〕，基为其上所立者（讀，AI）；先计基是所给之序，不由依存推得，贵贱与侯王之义不带。
find: 它与无以小害大合为先基后次之序（`Becoming.Lexical.BasicPriority`、`Becoming.Lexical.Above`）。基是两层之比中先计之层，基辞是此层之辞；名取老子「高以下为基」〔YD-LAO-BASE〕，基为其上所立者（讀，AI）；先计基是所给之序，不由依存推得，贵贱与侯王之义不带。
